The Lallantop Show, Episode no. 2126| 2 November 2026
In today’s LT show, Abhishek is discussing the following news:
In Today’s The Lallantop Show, we will discuss the BJP's ‘Loktantra Bachao, Arajakata Hatao’ padayatra. The BJP has taken out this padayatra across various parts of the country, including Hyderabad. It is being led by Amit Shah. The BJP's padayatra is being viewed in contrast to yesterday's opposition rally. We will understand the significance of this padayatra from the experts.
